title: Evaluation of the one-hot encoding
statement: For every finite type $\alpha$ and Boolean assignment $a$ on $\alpha$, the one-hot CNF encoding evaluates to true if and only if there is some $j\in\alpha$ such that $a(i)$ is true exactly when $i=j$, for every $i\in\alpha$.
